questions.question: Have you created a PCB design from requirements through schematic, placement, layout review, and fabrication output? Please distinguish clearly between work you personally performed and work you reviewed or tested.
questions.rationale: PCB design is a high-weight missing competency; the wording verifies scope without inferring undocumented design ownership.

questions.question: At Zoom, you overhauled programming and testing processes with management. Describe how you identified the problem, aligned stakeholders, introduced the new process, and measured whether it improved delivery or quality.
questions.rationale: Probes a documented leadership and process-improvement accomplishment that can indicate effectiveness in a cross-functional engineering environment.
source_evidence: Overhauled programming and testing processes and infrastructure with management
Scheduled due dates and tracked projects to completion

questions.question: Suppose an image-capture subsystem intermittently stops responding after several hours in the field. How would you design the embedded controller architecture and diagnostic strategy to isolate and recover from the fault?
questions.rationale: Embedded controller implementation is the highest-weight missing requirement and is central to the job's product work.

questions.question: This position requires onsite work five days per week and close interaction with manufacturing. What specifically motivates you to move from hardware test and repair into this hands-on digital engineering role, and how would you build effective day-to-day relationships with production partners?
questions.rationale: Assesses motivation for the transition and collaboration style using the candidate's documented training, manufacturing-adjacent, and hardware-test background.
source_evidence: Primary trainer on test procedure software development and documentation
Assembled and maintained records for component kits for shipment to manufacturing

questions.question: Describe the most complex digital circuit or electronic assembly you have diagnosed or tested. How did you move from the schematic and observed symptoms to a defensible root-cause conclusion?
questions.rationale: Tests whether the candidate's circuit fundamentals and component-level debug experience extend to design-level digital reasoning required for the role.

questions.question: Give an example of a programming or test procedure you revised that improved repeatability or reduced manufacturing errors. How did you control revisions, train users, and verify that the change worked on the production floor?
questions.rationale: Builds on the candidate's documented procedure, documentation, and training experience while testing the manufacturing-facing documentation requirement.
source_evidence: Created and revised programming and testing procedures
Trained staff on test procedure software development and documentation

questions.question: What experience, if any, do you have with Texas Instruments Code Composer Studio? If it is new to you, outline how you would bring up, build, flash, and debug a TI microcontroller project during your first week.
questions.rationale: Code Composer Studio is explicitly required and missing from the documented profile.

questions.question: Which development environments have you used to build, flash, debug, and version embedded software? Describe the workflow you would establish when joining a team that uses an unfamiliar IDE.
questions.rationale: No IDE-tool experience is documented, so this assesses both direct exposure and an evidence-based learning approach.
